subject: High School Construction Delivery Method
overview: The committee voted to use the Construction Manager at Risk delivery method for the high school project and appointed district representatives to the evaluation committee.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the minutes from the previous meeting for submission to the MSBA.

items.title: Construction Delivery Method Presentation and Vote
items.summary: Voted to proceed with the Construction Manager at Risk delivery method and authorized Left Field to submit the application to the Office of the Inspector General following a presentation comparing delivery options.

items.title: CM Evaluation Committee Appointments
items.summary: Appointed Dr. Galussi, Jenny Graham, Ken Lord, Libby Brown, and Brian Hilliard as district representatives on the evaluation committee to select the construction manager.
